From that moment on, Fritz built a unique path, creating a musical language where deep emotion, groove and storytelling coexist in perfect harmony.
With countless chart‑topping releases, headline performances across Europe and his own imprint Nasua Music, Fritz continues to shape the melodic electronic landscape with the same authenticity and passion that made him a global reference.

🖼 Fam… meet @yeko_yekill Live Painting this Saturday at our Golden Hour Ceremony at @seaseaclub.bcn 🌊
His art is a break in the clouds, and this Saturday, with a full sunny day ahead, his universe rises with us 🌅🔥

Yeko began painting walls around 2008, captivated from childhood by graffiti and urban art. Growing up between Valencia and Orihuela, surrounded by high‑level street art, he spent years filling sketchbooks, shaping the style that would later define him.

He focused his studies on expanding his artistic vision, graduating in Design and Creative Technologies in 2020 and completing a Master in Digital Illustration & Concept Art in 2023.

Murals have always been the core of his work, eventually becoming his full time profession. His journey has taken him to major institutions, international projects and collaborations abroad. He has painted at top graffiti festivals across Europe such as Roskilde Festival, Southend City Jam and Step In The Arena, sharing walls with countless urban artists from around the world.

His universe blends fantasy, mythology, medieval and gothic atmospheres, imaginary beings and visual storytelling. Sometimes he shifts into futuristic sci‑fi aesthetics, always with strong concept art influences. And coming from graffiti, letters are essential, he loves Wildstyle, often merging it with characters and environments to create powerful, symbolic narratives.

This Saturday, his world becomes part of our Ceremony, a visual explosion under the sun, a canvas becoming alive in front of the Fam! 💥🙌

This Saturday 19.09, she joins our Art Division at the next Golden Hour Ceremony at @seaseaclub.bcn with a powerful Live Painting performance! 🙌

Connor is a self‑taught muralist, tattoo artist and painter from Barcelona. She has been painting since childhood, and at just 18 she began her professional journey. Since then, she has collaborated with municipalities, participated in urban art festivals and performed live paintings across Spain. Her work has also crossed borders, taking her to Peru, Brazil and Chile, where she has painted in international festivals and intervened both public and private spaces.

Her art explores emotion and human connection through the female figure. She blends realism with transformed, fused or distorted elements to build symbolic visual narratives. Each piece is created with the intention of transmitting a message and awakening a sensation, inviting the viewer into an emotional experience that goes far beyond the image.
